reports.summary: Skipper is the cleanest listed proxy for the tower and overhead-line leg of India's transmission build-out — a capacity-led, low-cost manufacturer entering FY27 with a record ₹8,502 Cr order book, a ₹33,000 Cr bidding pipeline, and a demonstrated FY26 in which profit and cash flow grew roughly…
